metadata.title: Uncle Iroh Wisdom
metadata.description: Memorable quotes from Uncle Iroh (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

quotes.quote: Pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame.
It is important to draw wisdom from many different places. If you take it from only one place, it becomes rigid and stale.
Life happens wherever you are, whether you make it or not.
quotes.context: To Zuko in Ba Sing Se

quotes.quote: Sometimes the best way to solve your own problems is to help someone else.
quotes.episode: The Tales of Ba Sing Se

quotes.quote: Failure is only the opportunity to begin again. Only this time, more wisely.
You must never give into despair. Allow yourself to slip down that road and you surrender to your lowest instincts.
In the darkest times, hope is something you give yourself. That is the meaning of inner strength.
Protection and power are overrated. I think you are very wise to choose happiness and love.
While it is always best to believe in oneself, a little help from others can be a great blessing.
Destiny is a funny thing. You never know how things are going to work out.
Sharing tea with a fascinating stranger is one of life's true delights.
quotes.context: To Toph when they first meet

quotes.quote: There is nothing wrong with a life of peace and prosperity. I suggest you think about what it is that you want from your life.
It is usually best to admit mistakes when they occur, and to seek to restore honor.
You are not the man you used to be. You are stronger and wiser and freer than you ever used to be.
A man needs his rest.
Are you so busy fighting you cannot see your own ship has set sail?
quotes.context: Warning about losing sight of what matters

quotes.quote: Who would have thought that after all these years, I would return to the scene of my greatest military disgrace... as a tourist!
I know you're not supposed to cry over spilled tea, but it's just so sad!
Sick of tea? That's like being sick of breathing!
The only thing better than finding something you're looking for is finding something you weren't looking for at a great bargain!
Euch! This tea is nothing more than hot leaf juice!
I was never angry with you. I was sad because I was afraid you'd lost your way.
You have light and peace inside of you. If you let it out, you can change the world around you.
Perfection and power are overrated. I think you are very wise to choose happiness and love.
Be careful what you wish for. History is not always kind to its subjects.
Sometimes, life is like this dark tunnel. You can't always see the light at the end of the tunnel, but if you just keep moving... you will come to a better place.
quotes.context: To Team Avatar in the cave

quotes.quote: Good times become good memories, but bad times become good lessons.
You sound like my nephew, always thinking you need to do things on your own without anyone's support.
Even in the material world, you will find that if you look for the light, you can often find it. But if you look for the dark, that is all you will ever see.
quotes.context: To Korra in the Spirit World
quotes.episode: Legend of Korra - A New Spiritual Age

quotes.quote: No, she's crazy and she needs to go down.
quotes.context: About Azula - rare moment of bluntness
